node.title: Re: Running aldec simulation command using per system() function !!!
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: Here's my obligatory link to [id://1180578|my node] where I discuss running external commands using various modules. [mod://IPC::System::Simple] is a drop-in replacement for Perl's [doc://system] with much better error reporting, that way you can get some error messages to find out what might be going wrong to start with. Although I think [hippo] is probably [id://11107295|right] about the interpolation of @acdb_file_list. Also, always [id://111088] for more helpful messages from Perl.
